item.title: GRE Word Puzzle #5: a 6-letter adjective starting with T
item.description:
Unscramble today's GRE word. Some letters are already in place.

(adjective) sluggish

Memory trick from the cartoon:

I R D O

6 letters. Put the purple tiles in the empty boxes.

Play puzzle #5

Yesterday's word: displacing (verb), removing from the usual place.

Every puzzle word comes from my GRE Vocab Cartoons app, which has all 1,359 cartoons and keeps bringing back the ones you miss until you know them: iPhone or Android.
